packageRules.description: the plain Quadlet units are read by Renovate's own quadlet manager. They stay tag-pinned rather than digest-pinned: kuma's `2` and searxng's date tags move on their own, so a digest pin would open a PR on every upstream rebuild and turn the reviewable version bump into noise (docker:pinDigests still applies to the Containerfiles, where the base image is built once)

same for the three rendered templates and the two script defaults: their deps come from the regex manager, which can only rewrite an existing digest, so inheriting docker:pinDigests made Renovate try to *add* one and fail the branch with 'Digest is not updated' / 'update failure' -- aborting that branch's real upgrades with it
localhost/* images are built on this host (deploy.sh or install.sh), not pulled: there is no registry to look them up in, and the attempt only earns 401s in the log
hand-pinned on purpose: the Postgres cluster is upgraded by the operator, not by a PR (renovate.json's own rule, documented in AGENTS.md)

the backup tool updates like no other unit: backup.container is a oneshot on a nightly timer, so a changed tag IS a missing image and podman pulls it on the next run -- no ./deploy.sh --only backup, unlike every other pinned unit
prBodyNotes: Merging this needs no deploy step: the next `backup.timer` run sees a missing image and pulls it. Afterwards run `./scripts/backup.sh list` and `./scripts/backup.sh check` to confirm the new binary reads the existing repository (it is format v2, so the tag must never go below 0.17).

packageRules.description: monerod and its wallet-rpc must land together: a wallet older than the daemon it talks to is unsupported, and a Monero upgrade is a hardfork deadline, not a convenience

SearXNG tags are <date>-<commit>, so every build has a different suffix and docker versioning calls them incompatible; loose compares the date part, which keeps it at one rolling PR a week instead of never
the daemons that hold consensus state or terminate TLS are never automerged, and the PR body says what applying it actually costs
prBodyNotes: Merging this changes the tag only: the host keeps running the old image until `./deploy.sh --only <service>` pulls the new one, followed by `./verify.sh`.

Consensus daemons: read the upstream release notes first. `lightningd` wallet migrations are forward-only, so run `./scripts/backup.sh backup` before deploying it; Monero upgrades are driven by a hardfork height and the daemon and wallet move as a pair.

customManagers.description: the three rendered unit *templates* and the three image defaults that live in shell. Renovate's quadlet manager matches only *.container, so deploy/*.container.in (fulcrum, lightningd, monero-wallet-rpc -- the units install.sh renders, because they carry secrets) is invisible to it, and no manager reads a shell default (wallets.sh's MONERO_IMAGE, monitor.sh's APPRISE_IMAGE, backup.sh's RESTIC_IMAGE). These stay tag-pinned too; the packageRules entry below turns digest pinning off for them, because a regex manager can only *update* a digest, never add one.
the shellcheck release CI pins and downloads (SHELLCHECK_VERSION in .github/workflows/ci.yml)
the btc-rpc-explorer master commit pinned in btc-explorer/Containerfile (the published npm 3.4.0 is stale and does not build on Node 22)
the MoneroBlock release commit pinned in xmr-explorer/Containerfile (the project's last tag is v0.1.2; current main is the same commit)
